verdict.rationale: Riveter's enrichment API takes a natural-language prompt plus a list of attribute names and fills structured columns using AI and web scrapes. Its AI agents interpret pages the way a person would, so no selectors are needed, and the API explicitly covers extracting data from complicated websites. Missing for 10: an explicit single-page extract endpoint documented with a URL input and a schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors

citations.quote: An enrichment takes rows of input data and fills in new columns using AI, web searches, web scrapes, and other tools.
You can build one from a natural-language prompt or a structured spec, and Riveter will generate the rows for you.
Riveter uses AI agents that interpret pages the way a person would, so the same configuration keeps working after a redesign.
extract data from complicated websites programmatically
